name: DVWA Web Security Lab
description: Practice safe web application reconnaissance and evidence collection against an isolated DVWA target.
learningObjectives: Explain the observed web security control.
instructions: Start the lab, inspect only the isolated target named dvwa, and record your observations before acknowledging each task.

tasks.title: Inspect the web target
tasks.description: Use the isolated Kali workspace to inspect the DVWA target and record one useful observation.
hints: Keep all requests inside the lab network.
tasks.completionRequirements: Acknowledge that you recorded an observation from the isolated target.
